hidden_sync_blockers_eliminated.new_flow: Store AbyssalPathPendingJob and commit from CompleteAbyssalPathJob; optional smoothing overlays degrade to default inputs instead of forcing pathSourceHandle completion.
hidden_sync_blockers_eliminated.phase: Schedule in caller phase, non-forced completion in LateFrameTick dispatcher gate
hidden_sync_blockers_eliminated.consumer_after_fence: CommitAbyssalPathResult and DataVault publish for BufferID.VegetationAbyssalPathSnapshot.

hidden_sync_blockers_eliminated.old_call: Worker jobs consumed live BufferID.VegetationEcosystemThreatGrid NativeArray views from TryReadVegetationMemoryBuffer.
hidden_sync_blockers_eliminated.new_flow: ScheduleThreatPropagationJob copies currentThreat into PreviousThreat; ScheduleFlowFieldJob copies currentThreatGrid into ThreatGridSnapshot; both snapshots are owned by pending structs and released in completion finally paths.
hidden_sync_blockers_eliminated.consumer_after_fence: ThreatPropagationJob, ThreatVoxelizationJob, and BuildAbyssalFlowFieldJob read TempJob snapshots instead of live DataVault views.

hidden_sync_blockers_eliminated.new_flow: Read accessors and SlowTick rebuild no longer complete HLOD jobs; HLOD completion remains in the LateFrameTick dispatcher gate.

jobhandle_chains.producer_chain: grass, kelp, and floating record jobs are scheduled and combined before ChunkBuildPendingJob is published.
jobhandle_chains.completion_gate: FinalizeCompletedChunkBuilds checks Handle.IsCompleted; FinalizeChunkBuildJob uses non-forced DispatcherJobSwap.TryComplete before payload read.

jobhandle_chains.producer_chain: ThreatPropagationJob schedules first using PreviousThreat TempJob snapshot; voxel job schedules with threatHandle as dependency.
jobhandle_chains.completion_gate: CompleteThreatPropagationJob fences final voxel handle before DataVault snapshot copy and releases PreviousThreat in finally.

jobhandle_chains.producer_chain: FlowFieldJob schedules from density, attractor, nav support, and ThreatGridSnapshot TempJob snapshots.
jobhandle_chains.completion_gate: CompleteFlowFieldJob fences flow handle before DataVault snapshot copy and releases ThreatGridSnapshot in finally.

jobhandle_chains.producer_chain: BuildAbyssalThermalGridJob schedules first; flow-volume job schedules with thermalHandle as dependency.
jobhandle_chains.completion_gate: CompleteThermalGridJob fences final flow-volume handle before publish and biolume surge state update.

jobhandle_chains.producer_chain: GroundRadarRaymarchJob schedules as a worker IJob. Ore SoA reads are registered through IWorldResourceSpawnerReadDependencySink; when no sink exists, ore arrays are dropped and the scan fails closed.
jobhandle_chains.completion_gate: CompleteRadarJob uses DispatcherJobFence.TryComplete before CommitCompletedScan, then releases SDF and GPR DataVault buffer locks in finally.

jobhandle_chains.producer_chain: NativeAStarJob schedules first when macro voxel route is unavailable; StringPullPathJob schedules with pathSourceHandle as dependency. A* threat grid/voxel and smoothing passability/threat inputs are copied to TempJob snapshots.
jobhandle_chains.completion_gate: CompleteAbyssalPathJob uses DispatcherJobSwap.TryComplete before CommitAbyssalPathResult, then ReleaseAbyssalPathPendingJob releases every pending native payload in finally.

datavault_lifetime.finding: No new DataVault fields were migrated. Vegetation jobs publish through existing BufferID lanes after dispatcher fences. Threat propagation, flow-field solving, and abyssal A* no longer capture live ecosystem threat DataVault arrays across frames. GPR now keeps existing TryLockBuffer locks until scheduled raymarch completion.
datavault_lifetime.job_memory_owner: Vegetation TempJob/H8Memory pending structs stay alive until dispatcher-fenced completion; threat propagation releases PreviousThreat in ReleaseThreatPropagationPendingJob; flow-field solving releases ThreatGridSnapshot in ReleaseFlowFieldPendingJob; abyssal A* threat snapshots are released through pathSourceHandle; GPR persistent Vault buffers remain locked while the worker owns slices.
datavault_lifetime.publish_order: vegetation: fence -> TryCopyVegetationMemorySnapshot -> metadata update -> Release*PendingJob in finally; abyssal path: Schedule A*/StringPull -> CompleteAbyssalPathJob fence -> CommitAbyssalPathResult -> ReleaseAbyssalPathPendingJob in finally; GPR: ScheduleRadarJob locks -> job.Schedule -> CompleteRadarJob fence -> CommitCompletedScan -> UnlockSdfSnapshotBuffer/ReleaseScanJobBufferLocks in finally
datavault_lifetime.rejected_alternative: Holding DataVault write locks across asynchronous worker execution.

zero_gc_proof.note: Editor test source allocates strings/arrays only inside EditMode tests. Runtime hot-path method-body scan reports no reference-type new/string.Format/ToString/foreach/LINQ. Struct layout edits remain zero.

teardown_safety.on_disable: forces threat, flow, and thermal completion before DisposeThreatGridState, DisposeFlowFieldState, DisposeThermalGridState, and native aggregate disposal
teardown_safety.on_destroy: same forced completion order as OnDisable
teardown_safety.chunk_cancellation: CompleteAndReleaseChunkBuildJob force-fences pending chunk jobs before ReleaseChunkBuildPendingJob
teardown_safety.ground_radar: Dispose calls CompleteRadarJob(forceComplete: true) before clearing DataVault handles; CompleteRadarJob releases SDF and GPR buffer locks in finally.
